## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

Wèi Zhīxiù's continuation of the [江瓘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%9F%E7%93%98) Jiāng Guàn / [江應宿](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%9F%E6%87%89%E5%AE%BF) Jiāng Yìngsù ***Míngyī lèiàn*** ([KR3e0075](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3e/KR3e0075)), in 60 juan, completed shortly before Wèi's death in 1772. The *Xù* gathers Qīng-period and additional pre-Qīng case-records into a comprehensive supplementary collection, organized by disease-category to parallel the original. The combined *Míngyī lèiàn* + *Xù míngyī lèiàn* is the standard pre-modern Chinese case-record reference. The work was completed in Wèi's last years and presented to the SKQS by his family after his death.

**Abstract**

Composition window: 1770–1772, Wèi's final years.

The work's significance:

(a) **The standard Qīng-period continuation of the *Míngyī lèiàn* tradition**: as a 60-juan supplement, the *Xù* is one of the most substantial Qīng-period case-record compilations.

(b) **The combined *Míngyī lèiàn* + *Xù* as standard reference**: together with [KR3e0075](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3e/KR3e0075), the *Xù* completes the standard pre-modern Chinese case-record reference. The combined corpus has been fundamental to modern TCM case-based-medicine pedagogy.

(c) **The Wèi-Zhīxiù-as-philological-editor career**: Wèi's annotation of the parent *Míngyī lèiàn* and composition of the *Xù* represent one of the more cohesive Qīng-period medical-textual-scholarly careers.

The catalog meta dynasty 清 is correct; lifedates d. 1772.
